The purpose of this script is to determine the relationship between plant performance and final community composition based on presence/absence.

Load the packages 
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
library(vegan)
library(ape)
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorRamps)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(ggord)
library(viridis)
library(agricolae)
library(emmeans)
library(Rmisc)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(microbiome)
library(DESeq2)
library(corrplot)
library(olsrr)
library(psadd)
library(lme4)
library(RRPP)
library(ggforce)
library(ggpattern)
library(ggordiplots)
```

#Fungi RRPP with presence absence data
```{r}
presence_absence_fung<-read.csv("presence_absence_OTUtable.csv",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)
colnames(presence_absence_fung)=sub("X","",colnames(presence_absence_fung))

metadata<-read.csv("Total_Harvest_Data.csv",sep=",",header=TRUE, row.names=1)
options(na.action="na.fail")
#remove blanks and mocks
metadata<-metadata[-c(360:390),]
#remove monocultures
metadata<-subset(metadata, Diversity.Level !="Mono")

#make sure columns match between metadata and community samples
#remove row 252 in metadata because its an outlier 
metadata<-metadata[-c(252),]
presence_absence_fung<-t(presence_absence_fung)
presence_absence_fung<-as.data.frame(presence_absence_fung)
presence_absence_fung <- presence_absence_fung[rowSums(presence_absence_fung) != 0, ]
metadata = metadata[row.names(metadata) %in% row.names(presence_absence_fung),]
presence_absence_fung = presence_absence_fung[row.names(presence_absence_fung) %in% row.names(metadata),]

#make the columns in the same order
presence_absence_fung <- presence_absence_fung[rownames(metadata),]

fung_vegdist<-vegan::vegdist(presence_absence_fung,method="jaccard")
fung_vegdist<-as.matrix(fung_vegdist)

#structure based on Montgomery with drought nested in microcosm
of2 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(fung_vegdist ~ Comm*Microcosm/Drought+ 1/TimeBlock,
data = metadata, SS.type = "III", print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)

anova(of2, effect.type = "F")
anova(of2, effect.type = "F", error =c("Comm:Microcosm:Drought","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals"))

#separate SynCom into pioneer and diversity treatments
of2 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(fung_vegdist ~ Pioneer*Diversity.Level*(Microcosm/Drought)+ 1/TimeBlock,
data = metadata, SS.type = "III", print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)
#remove row 252 in metadata because its an outlier 
anova(of2, effect.type = "F")
anova(of2, effect.type = "F", error =c("Pioneer:Microcosm:Drought","Diversity.Level:Microcosm:Drought","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals"))

of3 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(fung_vegdist ~ Pioneer,
data = metadata, SS.type = "III", print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)
anova(of3, effect.type = "F")

fit<-RRPP::pairwise(of3,groups=metadata$Pioneer)
print<-summary.pairwise(fit)
print<-summary(fit)
print2<-print$summary.table

fit<-RRPP::pairwise(of2,groups=metadata$Comm)
print<-summary.pairwise(fit)
print<-summary(fit)
print<-print$summary.table

```

Is final community associated with any plant performance metrics? 
```{r}
metadata_phys<-read.csv("Total_Phys_Data.csv",sep=",",header=TRUE, row.names=1)

metadata_phys$inversegsw<-1/(metadata_phys$gsw+0.5)

metadata_phys= metadata_phys[row.names(metadata_phys) %in% row.names(metadata),]
metadata= metadata[row.names(metadata) %in% row.names(metadata_phys),]
presence_absence_fung = presence_absence_fung[row.names(presence_absence_fung) %in% row.names(metadata_phys),]
presence_absence_fung <-as.data.frame(presence_absence_fung )

ps_fung<- phyloseq(otu_table(presence_absence_fung, taxa_are_rows=F),sample_data(metadata))
ps_distance<-phyloseq::distance(ps_fung,"jaccard")

metadata$gsw<-metadata_phys$gsw

#RRPP with distance matrix----------------------------------------------------------
of1 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(ps_distance ~gsw+ Height+Total_Shoot_Mass+Root.Shoot+Dry_Root_Mass+Ratio.of.BrownToTotal+Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf+1/TimeBlock,
                    data = metadata, SS.type = "III",
                    print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)
anova(of1, effect.type = "F")
anova(of1, effect.type = "F", error = c("Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals","Residuals"))

set.seed(345)
ord_fung <- phyloseq::ordinate(ps_fung, "NMDS", "jaccard")

fung_vegdist<-as.data.frame(fung_vegdist)
dist<-dist(presence_absence_fung)

ordination_scores <- as.data.frame(ord_fung$points)
#ordination_scores<-merge(ordination_scores,metadata,by="row.names")
#centroids <- aggregate(cbind(MDS1, MDS2) ~ P.Div, data = ordination_scores, FUN = mean)
nmds1_scores <- ordination_scores$MDS1
nmds2_scores<-ordination_scores$MDS2

metadata$nmds1<-nmds1_scores
metadata$nmds2<-nmds2_scores

c6<-c("#4477AA","#FF7F00","#CCBB44",
       "#228833","orchid1","black","grey")


c35 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", # red
  "green4",
  "#6A3D9A", # purple
  "#FF7F00", # orange
  "lavenderblush2", "gold1",
  "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", # lt pink
  "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", # lt purple
  "#FDBF6F", # lt orange
  "gray70", "khaki2",
  "maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4",
  "darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3",
  "darkorange4", "brown", 'moccasin', 'mediumvioletred', 'seagreen','cadetblue1',
                "darkolivegreen1" ,"black"
)

aggregated<-aggregate(cbind(nmds1,nmds2)~Pioneer*Diversity.Level,data=metadata,FUN=mean,na.rm=TRUE)
aggregated_sd<-aggregate(cbind(nmds1,nmds2)~Pioneer*Diversity.Level,data=metadata,FUN=sd,na.rm=TRUE)
aggregated$sd1<-aggregated_sd$nmds1
aggregated$sd2<-aggregated_sd$nmds2
 

ord_nmds<- ggplot(aggregated,aes(x=nmds1,y=nmds2,color=Pioneer,shape=Diversity.Level)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = 5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c6)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(17,15,16)) +
  theme_classic() +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=nmds2-sd2, ymax=nmds2+sd2))+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=nmds1-sd1, xmax=nmds1+sd1))+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 24))+
  labs(x="NMDS1", y="NMDS2")
ord_nmds

ord_nmds<- ggplot(metadata,aes(x=nmds1,y=nmds2,color=Pioneer,shape=Diversity.Level)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = 5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c6)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(17,15,16)) +
  theme_classic() +
  #stat_ellipse(aes(group=Persistence),type="t")+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 24))+
  labs(x="NMDS1", y="NMDS2")
ord_nmds

ord_bray_nmds<- plot_ordination(ps_fung,ord_fung,aes(color=Comm))  +
  geom_point(aes(color=Comm,size = 5)) +
  #scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,22, 24)) +
  #stat_ellipse(type = "t", linetype = 1, aes(group = interaction(SiteID, Treatment), color = interaction(SiteID, Treatment))) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c35)+
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
  ggtitle("NMDS")
ord_bray_nmds


#Is dispersion different between treatments?
grouping_variable <- metadata$Total_Shoot_Mass
dispersion <- vegan::betadisper(ps_distance, grouping_variable,type="centroid")
#permutest(dispersion, pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 99)
boxplot(dispersion)
```


Use betadisper to see if dispersion is different betweeen community groups in rrpp to explain lack of pairwise relationships
```{r}
#Is dispersion different between treatments?
ps_fung<- phyloseq(otu_table(presence_absence_fung,taxa_are_rows=F),sample_data(metadata))
ps_distance<-phyloseq::distance(ps_fung,"jaccard")
grouping_variable <- metadata$Comm
dispersion <- vegan::betadisper(ps_distance, grouping_variable,type="centroid")
test<-permutest(dispersion, pairwise = TRUE, permutations = 99)

df <- data.frame(
  group = dispersion$group,
  distance = dispersion$distances
)

c35 <- c( "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", # red
  "green4",
  "#6A3D9A", # purple
  "#FF7F00", # orange
  "lavenderblush2", "gold1",
  "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", # lt pink
  "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", # lt purple
  "#FDBF6F", # lt orange
  "gray70", "khaki2", "maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4","darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3", "darkorange4", "brown", 'moccasin', 'mediumvioletred', 'seagreen','cadetblue1',"darkolivegreen1" ,"black"
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = group, y = distance,color=group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c35)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))+
  labs(x = "Community", y = "Distance to centroid",
       title = "Group dispersions (betadisper)")

```

#Graphing inoculation vs what actually remained

graphingiso<-subset(graphing, Contam == "N")

graphingiso$Presence<- as.numeric(graphingiso$Presence)  

#separate isolates by community and actual
graphingactual<-subset(graphingiso, Presence == "Y")
